name: Ukor's Lost Pack

angles.text: Young Horde adventurers venturing through southern Durotar frequently assist locals like Ukor, proving their worth and reliability by recovering lost personal belongings from dangerous wildlife.

faq.answer: Ukor is an inhabitant residing in southern Durotar. When confronted by a massive spider in the arid wilds, he was forced to abandon his belongings in a desperate bid to escape safely.
Ukor dropped his pack while fleeing for his life from a huge spider lurking in Durotar. He assumed his belongings were gone for good until an adventurer tracked down the bag.
faq.q: Why did Ukor lose his pack?

faq.answer: The recovered pack belongs to Ukor, who can be found waiting in southern Durotar ready to greet returning travelers.
faq.q: Where does the pack need to be taken?

faq.answer: The pack is easily identified by Ukor's name, which is crudely stitched across the flap of the bag.
Ukor was ambushed by a huge spider wandering the terrain of southern Durotar, which terrified him enough to drop all his possessions and run for safety.
faq.q: What kind of creature chased Ukor?

faq.answer: Ukor is astonished and deeply grateful to see his lost belongings again, declaring the adventurer who retrieved his bag to be a true hero.
faq.q: What happens when you return the pack to Ukor?

sections.body: While traversing the arid wilderness of southern Durotar, an adventurer comes across an abandoned traveling bag with the name "Ukor" crudely stitched across its flap. Surviving in the harsh lands of Durotar leaves little room for careless wandering, and finding discarded gear usually points to an unfortunate encounter nearby.
sections.title: A Lost Belonging

sections.body: Upon returning the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar, the story behind its abandonment comes to light. Ukor dropped the bag in panic when he was ambushed by a massive spider native to the region, convinced he would never see his supplies again. Finding his bag intact earns the traveler heartfelt gratitude and praise.
sections.title: Fleeing the Wilds

summary: Ukor's Lost Pack is a dropped item found in the wilds of southern Durotar, bearing the crudely stitched name of its owner. It was discarded in haste when Ukor fled from a terrifying encounter with a huge spider native to the region.
